cases.source: Portfolio Cedar uses the reported profitability signal, with no sign transformation. At the monthly rebalance, take positive positions in firms with the greatest signal values and negative positions in firms with the least signal values. Positive positions are purchases; negative positions are short sales.
support_anchors: positive positions in firms with the greatest signal values and negative positions in firms with the least signal values
Positive positions are purchases; negative positions are short sales

cases.source: For Portfolio Quartz the input is accruals divided by assets. The least-accrual firms form the purchase portfolio; the greatest-accrual firms form the short-sale portfolio. Cash proceeds from the short sales are collateral, not an additional signal.
support_anchors: least-accrual firms form the purchase portfolio; the greatest-accrual firms form the short-sale portfolio

cases.source: Portfolio Harbor numbers deciles in descending order of signal: decile 1 has the largest values and decile 10 the smallest. Buy decile 10 and sell decile 1 short. The numbering is unchanged at each rebalance.
support_anchors: decile 1 has the largest values and decile 10 the smallest
Buy decile 10 and sell decile 1 short

cases.source: Portfolio Maple originally bought the bottom signal group and shorted the top group. That rule was withdrawn. The revised rule replaces it: buy the top signal group and short the bottom signal group. Use the revised rule for this portfolio.
support_anchors: The revised rule replaces it: buy the top signal group and short the bottom signal group

cases.source: Portfolio Aspen buys low signal values and sells high values short. Portfolio Flint reverses those positions: it buys high signal values and sells low values short. The requested experiment is Portfolio Flint only.
support_anchors: Portfolio Flint reverses those positions: it buys high signal values and sells low values short

cases.source: Portfolio Moss is a long-only investment fund. It purchases the highest-scoring firms and holds any residual balance in cash. It never borrows securities and never takes a short position.
Portfolio Slate sells the highest-scoring firms short. The document does not describe any purchases or long portfolio. No long-side selection rule can be recovered from the supplied passage.

cases.selected_strategy: Portfolio Birch at the current rebalance
cases.source: Portfolio Birch buys high scores and shorts low scores in regime A. In regime B it buys low scores and shorts high scores. The regime is set by an external indicator, whose value at the current rebalance is not supplied. Neither regime is the default.
